name: Miranda Holloway
source: Skyy is Emmett’s best friend since 7th grade. She’s very cheery and never fails to put Emmett in a good mood or reassure him when he’s down. Skyy’s fashion statements are much more “different” than other kids at school and she will pretty much dress however she wants to. She also is very fond of anime and fanfiction and is always happy to meet another student who is willing to share that interest with her.
